title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin trades at sixty-two thousand six hundred twenty-five dollars, down zero point eight percent, as fear sentiment locks in at twenty-seven on the index. Hashrate holds firm at nine hundred eighty-seven EH/s, reflecting sustained miner strength through the pullback. Mempool sits at eighty-two thousand transactions with fees bottoming at one sat per vbyte, keeping on-chain activity cheap and uncongested. Block height advances to nine hundred sixty thousand six hundred.
